reading: A zine/magazine cover page laid out as a ruled grid of boxes: a black heading band ("NOISE/ISSUE 9"), a left box with a sideways "LOUD" and intro copy, a blue duotone tile with yellow accent shapes, a track-listing box, a pull-quote box, a credits box with a tilted red "SOLD OUT SOON" badge, and a price box ("£4" / "post free in the UK"). All text content and styling were specified via typed notes anchored to each stroke group.
